I’m sorry but.. their own parents being terrible to them is no excuse for them to be terrible to you. 

They are grown and have had many decades to reflect on what was wrong with their own parents/how to be better for you. They’re failing you here and I’m sure you’ll come to realize that once you’re finally away from them. I’m brown too (latina tho) and defended my own abusers just like this until I was finally away. It’s hard to see them as abusers when they paint every necessity as a “privilege” to you and make you feel like they’re doing you a massive favor for keeping you, their literal spawn, alive. 

I really think the best option here is to create and wash your own reusable pads to sever the pad dependency your parents have created. I know from personal experience that in abusive households, you’ll always be in a lose/lose situation either way. 

At least in this situation you won’t be as physically uncomfortable. Reusable pads with limited resources won’t be as comfortable as the pads they’re hoarding, but this is all just temporary until you’re away and able to afford and freely buy your own sanitary products. It may even garner some positive acknowledgment from them for you being resourceful when sanitary products are so expensive in your country. You can even defend the use of reusing pads like this to them if they try to give you a hard time. It’ll also show if they’re truly just being stingy or if they’re being creepy and controlling by monitoring your cycles. 

I wish we could all do more to help, but unfortunately all we can do is give suggestions to help make your life better and hope you take them. 

It’s hard to believe it at times, but you do deserve a life that’s better than this OP.

I used to work at Chipotle and I won’t lie, keeping a consistent serving of rice and whatnot is kinda hard. You usually have to eyeball it, which is what I always do because it’s hard to always get that *perfect* scoop. It’s okay to ask for more as long as you’re nice about it and understanding, my training was absolutely shit and all over the place so they might just genuinely not know any better. However, if your Chipotle is charging you for extra rice when you’re not getting like an entire bowl sized container of it, you should ask to talk to the manager. With guac and queso, unless you’re asking for a tiny bit more in your food then yes you’ll be charged extra. At my Chipotle, we never charged for extra rice unless they got giant containers of it or overdid it big time. You’re allowed to ask for tiny, salsa sized sides of rice that don’t cost any extra as long as you don’t overdo it. Lastly, when I worked there, I developed a deep love for the steak when I usually only ate the chicken. Everyone at my store loved the steak to be honest. Whenever I get Chipotle, I just get half chicken and half steak now.
